resources.name: Animista
resources.description: A library of ready-to-use CSS animations that can be customized and copied directly into projects. It provides a visual interface for selecting, tweaking, and generating animation code for web development.

resources.name: shadcn/ui
resources.description: A collection of accessible, customizable React components distributed as source code. Unlike traditional component libraries, components are copied and pasted directly into your project, allowing full control over styling and behavior. Built with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI.

resources.name: Uiverse
resources.description: Community-driven library of open-source UI elements built with CSS and Tailwind CSS. Developers can browse, preview, and copy code for buttons, cards, forms, loaders, checkboxes, and other components. Elements can be exported to HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React, Vue, Svelte, Lit, or Figma for direct use in projects.

resources.name: Aceternity UI
resources.description: A library of copy-paste UI components and blocks built with Tailwind CSS and Motion for React. It provides animated and interactive elements like feature sections, hero sections, and cards that developers can quickly integrate into modern web projects.
